provenance.prepared_by: SeisFrame research workflow (example file, no engineering review)
provenance.purpose: Run case_0007 with the slab actions refined on nested meshes so that numerical slab evidence is produced and recorded; every engineering assertion stays false, so no slab layout is selected and the strong-column checks that need the developed slab stay unknown.

slab_refinement.tolerance_basis: Investigation criterion, not an ACI requirement or a validated error bound: the 5 percent all-strip screen inherited from the 2026-09-24 fixed-candidate benchmark (graded face meshes 12/24/48/60 cells per bay, at most two failed-witness face-band extensions inside the same 130,000-shell budget).

slab_refinement_basis: Numerical evidence only (2026-11-01): the case_0007 validation bundle declares this plan, tolerance, shell budget and stopping rule before solving; a failed or unresolved comparison stays failed and is never replaced by an earlier passing mesh. The tolerance is an investigation criterion, not an ACI requirement or a validated error bound.
